# atoms_from_mofdb_df { #mofography.data.atoms_from_mofdb_df }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Parse MOFdb DataFrame CIF strings into ASE Atoms (MOFdb tutorials).

```python
data.atoms_from_mofdb_df(mofdb_df)
```

Parse each MOFdb DataFrame ``cif`` column to ASE Atoms and attach ``info['name']`` from ``name``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                             | Default    |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------|------------|
| mofdb_df |        | the dataframe containing the MOFDB data | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|
|        |        | A list of atoms objects. |
